title: Niagara Falls Winter Tour Guided 3 Hour Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the best of Niagara in winter on a guided 3-hour sightseeing adventure. This tour blends iconic viewpoints, indoor attractions, and a scenic drive along the Niagara Parkway. Your guide brings winter scenery to life before you continue exploring at your own pace.

Begin at Journey Behind the Falls, descending through tunnels to platforms behind the Horseshoe Falls. Continue to the Whirlpool Observation Deck for sweeping views of the gorge and winter rapids. Next, step into the Butterfly Conservatory, a tropical retreat with over 2,000 free-flying butterflies.

Enjoy a scenic drive along the Parkway with a lookout stop at the Adam Beck and Robert Moses power stations, then turn around at the Floral Clock. Your experience continues independently with included self-guided access to the Niagara Parks Power Station and Niagara Takes Flight, plus WEGO Bus and Incline passes valid for two consecutive days.
